summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Devices (heartbeat timeline), Pengaturan (store hours dialog) and Laporan (report hours note + overview open-state) for owner@tokopilot.id. All 15 spec assertions passed. Toko Pilot store hours were flipped to 09:00-21:00, verified on Laporan, and restored to 'Buka 24 jam' at the end as required.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog content is taller than 900px viewport; submit button 'Simpan' rendered below viewport when window height=900 and Playwright click() reports 'element is outside of the viewport' (repro on desktop 1920x900). Worked after scroll_into_view + force=True and at 1920x1200. Consider making the modal body scrollable (overflow-y:auto with max-height:90vh) or shrinking padding so Simpan is reachable on shorter screens (e.g. laptops).

issues: Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' in console — harmless but noisy; ResponsiveContainer needs a sized parent.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Make StoreDialog scrollable/shorter so Simpan is reachable on 900px-tall viewports.
OPTIONAL: Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent sizing to silence width/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports page correctly threads 09:00-21:00 hours into report-range-label AND report-hours-note.

overview-open-state text is 'buka (09:00–21:00)' — includes the range in parentheses. Spec says text should be 'buka' or 'tutup'; the leading token is correct but includes extra context. Acceptable but E1 may want to trim to bare 'buka'/'tutup' if strict conformance is required.
HeartbeatTimeline renders 6 segments with data-status attributes (e.g., 'connected') and uptime '89,7% terhubung' — locale-formatted % as expected for id-ID.
StoreDialog correctly toggles 24h checkbox <-> time inputs, persists 09:00-21:00 and prefills on reopen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (15/15 assertions after correcting overly strict regex on overview-open-state)

seed_data_creation: None. Toko Pilot hours toggled 24h -> 09:00-21:00 -> restored to 24h (final state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toko Pilot is left at 'Buka 24 jam' (hours=null). Synthetic heartbeat rows for dev-pilot-01 (~1350) preserved. StoreDialog has a minor viewport-height bug on 900px-tall screens; the Simpan button falls below the viewport. If retesting, use viewport height >=1100 or scroll_into_view+force click.
rca of the issue: StoreDialog fills more than 900px vertically at 1920 width (header + form fields + 24h checkbox + open + close + timezone + name + save button). No overflow scroll on the dialog body, so Simpan can be clipped. Simple fix: max-h:90vh + overflow-y:auto on the dialog container.
